turndown.label: SO-flagged accepted turn-down against FPN, net, per drawn wind BM unit
turndown.basis: Atlas nowcast basis; not Elexon indicative, not settlement
turndown.measure: net SO-flagged turn-down against the unit's own FPN (MWh), this unit only

window.rule: settlement periods starting at or after the request time minus 7 days
window.ahead_note: Periods that had not started at the request time hold only the acceptances issued by then; their figures can rise in a later snapshot.

conservation.identity: drawn units + not drawn = GB wind total (LOC_AGG_v1)

turndown.location_note: Class A: exact registry location. Class B: name-matched location, 88% measured same-site precision on 42 wind units, drawn with a 5 km ring. No location has been verified by a person.

boundaries.label: NESO day-ahead forecast of pre-action flow and limit, published D−1. A forecast, not a measurement.
boundaries.wording: NESO day-ahead forecast, made before NESO's actions. A forecast, not a measurement.
boundaries.stress_rule: stress = forecast flow / forecast limit; forecast binding when stress ≥ 1 (DA_STRESS_v1); a placeholder limit is shown as no limit modelled, never as 0% stress
boundaries.mapping_rule: Group to ETYS line is a Neura mapping (BOUNDARY_GEOM_v1), unverified: mapped = two or more evidence types agree; candidate = one; list-only groups have no line drawn.

groups.render_reason: evidence conflicts (pypsa_gb_crosswalk states B2) and no candidate line has agreeing evidence of its own; listed, not drawn
one evidence type (otf_limit_match) agrees on B7; none conflicts
3 independent evidence types agree on B6; none conflicts
one evidence type (otf_limit_match) agrees on B9; none conflicts
NESO's OTF data names this group's boundary DRESHEX, and NESO's ETYS boundary file has no line of that name; listed, not drawn
one evidence type (otf_limit_match) agrees on LE1; none conflicts
candidate in the Atlas, listed only here: the registry carries an unresolved note against this mapping that no person has checked
NESO's OTF data names this group's boundary GM SNOW, and NESO's ETYS boundary file has no line of that name; listed, not drawn
NESO's OTF data names this group's boundary B6a, and NESO's ETYS boundary file has no line of that name; listed, not drawn

otf.label: NESO OTF weekly boundary limits, published under ETYS names (no Neura mapping)

interconnectors.label: NESO Demand Data Update, actual rows; +ve import to GB; published with a lag, not live
interconnectors.sign: NESO field description: +ve signifies import power into GB; -ve signifies export power out from GB.
interconnectors.selection_note: highest import and highest export are selected from the published values shown; no mean or GB net sum is given

index.label: Curtailment index, GB wind, monthly (separate context: a different basis and scope from the map markers; never summed with them)

series.name: GB wind BM units: accepted turn-down and Elexon-indicative cashflow
series.scope: BM units of Elexon fuel type WIND held in the validation store (atlas.backfill_indicative)
series.basis: Elexon indicative (BOAV volumes, ISPSTACK cashflows; not settlement)

measures.label: accepted turn-down, net (bid + offer on negative pairs, all acceptances)
accepted bid volume on negative pairs (gross bid)
Elexon-indicative bid-side cashflow on negative pairs (positive = paid to the unit)
Elexon-indicative net cashflow on negative pairs (positive = paid to the unit)

coverage.completeness_rule: a period is complete when every settlement period of every day is in sp_loaded (dataset IND_WIND) at the as-of instant
